views.markdown: Makes app backgrounds dark using iOS's Smart Invert, one app at a time. Pictures and videos are left alone in most apps. It can run on a schedule, and the Home Screen can stay light.

- Dark backgrounds in any app
- Keeps photos and pictures in their real colours
- Pick which apps stay light
- Always on, or only during hours you choose
- Home Screen and system UI can stay normal

1.0.4: new peanut icon.

1.0.3: fixes apps sometimes ending up with inverted colours. Umbra now always uses Smart Invert (never Classic), switches the moment you change apps instead of up to 3 seconds later, and keeps photos and large pictures in their real colours. New Keep Pictures Normal switch.
